# Product Notes: quick-status-yam23-20260602-150122

This case was generated by a real Hermes Agent Runtime Manager run against cloud-dev yam23.
Use it as a canonical Runtime raw-event fixture only if `completeFromEventIdOne=true` and final status is completed.

Expected product behaviors:
- live reasoning is made of delta chunks in event order;
- tool progress is represented by tool.started/tool.completed;
- final answer streams via message.delta and run.completed;
- status.message remains Runtime-internal and should not be user-visible by default.
